assumptions_and_caveats: This only checks a necessary first-integral condition after replacing a disk galaxy with the paper's sphericalized source prescription.
The exact interpolation assumption is piecewise linear Vobs(r) within each adjacent-data panel; it is numerical quadrature, not an asserted continuous observational model.
No per-point errors are supplied for Vgas, Vdisk, or their geometry conversion, so these component curves are held fixed; only Upsilon's published uncertainty is propagated.
Velocity errors are treated as independent Gaussian errors in Vobs; distance, inclination, and calibration uncertainties are not included.

The inner point has errV greater than Vobs, so Gaussian propagation through Vobs^2 and Vobs^4 is strongly nonlinear there; the Monte Carlo summaries are more informative than the first-order GLS metric for the full range.
The free integration constant is required because the first observed point is r_min=0.32 kpc; no condition is specified inside it. The last observed point is not used as a boundary condition.
classification: spherical-surrogate necessary-condition screen; not a physical NGC 3198 prediction
derivation: Paper Eq. (8): g' = -2g/r - 4 pi G rho - K g^2.
Define b(r)=Upsilon Vdisk(r)^2 + Vgas(r)*abs(Vgas(r)); the paper's spherical surrogate gives 4 pi G rho = (r b)'/r^2.
Multiply by r^2 and integrate: r^2 g + r b + K integral[rmin,r] s^2 g(s)^2 ds = C.
Set g=-Vobs^2/r: r*(b - Vobs^2) + K integral[rmin,r] Vobs^4 ds = C.

fixed_stellar_normalization.source: Pszota & Van 2024 Table 1, NGC 3198 thermodynamic gravity fit
fixed_stellar_normalization.treatment: fixed at published central value; its quoted uncertainty is propagated as one shared nuisance in the linearized covariance and the Monte Carlo draws; not refit

gas_convention: SPARC signed gas contribution is Vgas*abs(Vgas), so negative Vgas remains negative in b(r).

input_data.column_convention: Rad, Vobs, errV, Vgas, Vdisk, Vbul, SBdisk, SBbul; units from archive header

integration.boundary_condition: free integration constant C fitted on each selected range; no outer observed endpoint imposed as a boundary
integration.primary: exact panel integral of Vobs^4 under piecewise-linear interpolation between adjacent observed points
integration.secondary: independent 8-point Gauss-Legendre quadrature of the same piecewise-linear interpolant

residual_metric.limitations: the propagated GLS covariance is linearized; the Monte Carlo distribution addresses nonlinear powers but assumes independent Gaussian input errors and fixed component curves.
residual_metric.monte_carlo: 100,000 independent Gaussian draws using every row's errV jointly across all cumulative integrals and one shared Gaussian Upsilon draw; each draw refits C and K by unweighted OLS.
residual_metric.primary_fit: unweighted least-squares line Y=C-KX, with Y=r*(b-Vobs^2), X=int[rmin,r] Vobs^4 dr; report RMS(Y+KX-C) and its ratio to RMS(Y).
residual_metric.uncertainty_fit: single-pass feasible GLS with full first-order covariance from every independent observed-velocity error in both local Y and all shared cumulative X values, plus one shared Upsilon uncertainty; covariance frozen at central OLS K; chi2 uses two fitted coefficients.

title: Independent integrated stationary thermodynamic-gravity identity screen: NGC 3198
